intro: Section 23.9 covers hypnosis: its history and definition, hypnotizability as a stable trait, induction, and the indications and contraindications of hypnosis in psychiatry and medicine. A dashed box adds a 2024 umbrella review of the evidence for hypnosis.
objectives: Define hypnosis and outline its history.
Explain hypnotizability as a trait and how it is assessed.
State the indications and contraindications of hypnosis.
